description: This file contains functions for parsing and collecting information about processes in Linux, specifically reading from /proc/<pid>/stat to determine process ancestry and parent process IDs, and functions to collect and trace process information during startup and exit events.

methods.name: int parse_proc_stat(struct strbuf * sb,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Parses the content of /proc/<pid>/stat to extract the process name and parent process ID, handling complex cases where process names contain special characters or spaces.

methods.name: int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Reads the /proc/<pid>/stat file for a given process ID, and uses parse_proc_stat to extract the process name and parent PID.

methods.name: void push_ancestry_name(struct strvec * names,pid_t pid)
methods.description: Recursively gathers the ancestry chain of process names starting from a given PID up to the root process.

methods.name: void trace2_collect_process_info(enum trace2_process_info_reason reason)
methods.description: Main function to collect process information; triggered on startup or exit, it gathers the process ancestry and logs it if tracing is enabled.

ctags.name: stat_parent_pid
ctags.pattern: /^static int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid, struct strbuf *name, int *statppid)$/
